principles.name: Atomicity Rule
principles.description: A step is atomic only if it has exactly one action, one input, one output. If it needs "and" to describe it, split it further.

principles.name: No Skip Rule
principles.description: Breadth-first only. Every sub-task of a layer must exist before any sub-task decomposes into atomic steps.

principles.name: Variable Exhaustion Rule
principles.description: Every configurable parameter an atomic step touches must be listed explicitly, even if it has a default value.

principles.name: Dependency Rule
principles.description: Every atomic step declares requires and produces. Both fields are mandatory -- this drives correct sequencing and node-connection inference.

principles.name: No Orphan Rule
principles.description: Every produces output must be consumed downstream or explicitly flagged terminal_output. An unconsumed output means a missing step.

principles.name: Tool Agnosticism Rule
principles.description: Steps are named by function, never by implementation. Implementation binding happens only at render time, never inside the tree.

principles.name: Coverage Checklist Rule
principles.description: Each domain has a mandatory list of layers that must all be present and non-empty. The tree is rejected if any mandatory layer is empty.
